items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: And I had known Pearl since back during the Jelly Roll Morton days in the 30's. And she asked me if I would go out there with her as her accompanist.

ctx.x: At that particular time, around 1950, the places where people were sent for a showcase were places out in Hollywood, and one of these places was The Macombo in Hollywood. It was a very swank club, and it was... I can remember, when I worked there, that every night it was just packed full of what seemed to be nothing but big movie stars. Anyway, when Pearl got this invitation to come out there, of course, she knew... And I guess her managers and everyone who had set up, they were preparing her for a Hollywood more…

So Pearl came to me and said this would be her big chance. And I had known Pearl since back during the Jelly Roll Morton days in the 30's. And she asked me if I would go out there with her as her accompanist. I made mention of the fact that I would love to go, but first of all, I had my band there, and I couldn't just walk away and leave the band to go on a thing with her. Well, she asked me if she could arrange with the manager of the club for me to put someone in my place until I came back, would it be okay. So…
